context: A public library needs a member-facing catalog and circulation workflow with lending rules, reservations, fines, staff permissions, accessibility, and recovery controls.

requirements.text: Members must be able to search the catalog by title, author, subject, and ISBN.
requirements.condition: by title author subject or ISBN

requirements.text: A member may have no more than five active loans at one time.
requirements.condition: no more than five at one time

requirements.text: Standard books must have a 21-day loan period calculated from checkout time.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how due dates are calculated.

requirements.text: Members with overdue items must be blocked from new checkouts until the items are returned.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask what happens when a member has overdue books.

requirements.text: The system should calculate overdue fines by material type and number of late days.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how overdue fines are determined.
requirements.condition: by material type and late days

requirements.text: Members should be able to reserve an unavailable book and join its FIFO waitlist.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask what happens when a requested book is unavailable.

requirements.text: A lost item charge must include the replacement price and a configurable processing fee.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask how lost books are handled.

requirements.text: Only librarians may waive fines or mark an item as lost.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask who may perform sensitive circulation actions.

requirements.text: The member catalog should meet WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard and contrast requirements.
Circulation data must be backed up daily and restorable within four hours.
requirements.reveal_condition: Ask about recovery after data loss.
